connector.name: Rootly by rootly.com
connector.registryDescription: Incident management, on-call scheduling, and intelligent analysis powered by Rootly.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.rootly.com over server sent events, also runs locally from the Python package rootly-mcp-server. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace com.rootly. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token for Rootly API (format: Bearer <YOUR_ROOTLY_API_TOKEN>)
